Dream Runner

Run through Max’s dream, switch lanes, jump fences and collect bones before time runs out.

Loading game…

Open game separately (opens in a new tab) ↗

A standalone web demo of PawPal’s Dream Runner minigame. Play in landscape mode on mobile. Escape pauses; in fullscreen, Escape exits fullscreen first.

How to play

Keyboard and mouse: switch lanes with A/D or Left/Right Arrow. Jump with Space, W, Up Arrow or a click outside the interface. Escape pauses.

Touchscreen: swipe left or right to switch lanes. Tap or swipe up to jump. Use the cloud Pause button to pause.

This demo does not use your PawPal save and does not save your score. No login is required.
